posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
EvanDan55:

I wonder why they're drawing so much attention to Tachyon, Tempest, Fanatic, and Nightmist fighting Baron Blade. Odd.

Well, this might be the source of a few odd plot points.  

We know that Nightmist gets hit by the regression darts (a weapon that seems designed to incapacitate Legacy or Beacon), so this is probably when it happens, which could cause her to search for new sources and access to power, triggering the changes that make her into Dark Watch Nightmist.

My guess is that Tachyon's presence is significant because it signifies her transistion to a leadership role, moving her closer to Team Leader Tachyon. 

I would think that Tempest would make sense for a mission to another world.  He's the only one of the three with direct experience (that we know of) with space travel, so it is possible that he went along as a the pilot.  It is not inconceivable that Tachyon managed to acquire his ship's wreckage from FILTER and restore it to working order!

Redeemer Fanatic's incap shows her crumpled on the desert sand, which could be on mars (perhaps the mars base's dome encompasses some of the martian desert?)  Or its entirely possible that the Baron has been terraforming!  This could also be related to the Prime Wardens, in that Fanatic and Tempest appear to be on that team.  Perhaps she went along specifically to watch Tempest's back?  Maybe she needed to test her faith on an alien world, under a strange sun?  I like to believe that she has devoted herself to being part of a team with the same zeal with which she holds her religious convictions, and will not let a fellow Warden go into battle alone!
